title: Oregon baseball vs. OSU Beavers: Live score updates, analysis - NewsBreak
text:
By Don Smalley ,
1 days ago Oregon Ducks baseball series vs. Michigan Wolverines April 4, 2025. By Chris Pietsch/The Register-Guard, Chris Pietsch/The Register-Guard / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images If Oregon Ducks head coach Mark Wasikowski had to tell the truth, he might have rather lost one more game in Las Vegas than lose tonight.
Oregon came home off a successful trip to Sin City, where it defeated Arizona and Vanderbilt , only to fall to in-state rival Oregon State 10-6 in a midweek matchup. It's just the Ducks' second defeat of the young season as they fell to 10-2. On the other hand, the Beavers improved to 7-4 this year and snapped a four-game losing streak to the Ducks.
Oregon started the game on the right foot in the first with Maddox Molony's ground-rule double that scored Ryan Cooney. But the Beavers took control of the game in the fifth inning with three runs to make it 5-1 Beavers. The Ducks' offense was stifled for much of the night by a host of Oregon State relievers. The Beavers sent seven pitchers to the mound. Only Trey Morris had trouble as he gave up two runs in the sixth and didn't get anyone out.
Unfortunately for Oregon, its pitching staff couldn't hold off the OSU bats enough for a sustained rally. By the time it was 7-1 in the sixth, the game was virtually over at that point. The Ducks made it interesting late as they scored three runs in the eighth to make it 10-6. But ultimately, that deficit was just too much to overcome.
Now Oregon can look toward conference action as the Ducks hit the road once again. Oregon will travel to Purdue (8-3) to open Big Ten play on Friday, March 6.
Beavers 10, Ducks 6 (Final) There would be no late rally at PK Park as Oregon State closer Isaac Yeager set the Ducks down in order to secure the win.
Beavers 10, Ducks 6 (Mid 9) Oregon State threatened to score and add to its lead, but Hudson Carvalho pitched his way out of trouble to keep the Beavers off the scoreboard and give his offense a fighting chance to rally late.
Beavers 10, Ducks 6 (End 8) Oregon put three on the board on a fielder's choice, an Angel Laya triple, and Burke-Lee Mabeus single to give the Ducks a fighting chance in the ninth. Laya has a home run, a triple and three runs driven in.
Beavers 10, Ducks 3 (Mid 8) Oregon reliever Leo Uelmen came on to retire the final two Beavers to secure the first perfect inning for the Ducks since the first.
Beavers 10, Ducks 3 (End 7) Oregon went down in order in the bottom of the seventh.
Beavers 10, Ducks 3 (Mid 7) Oregon's chances of a rally just diminished by a lot as Jacob Galloway hit a three-run double to right field to extend the Beavers' lead.
Beavers 7, Ducks 3 (End 6) Angel Laya cut into the deficit with a long home run to center, a two-run shot, to bring the Ducks to within four of the Beavers. It's his fourth homer of the season for the true freshman. Oregon has nine more outs to play with.
Beavers 7, Ducks 1 (Mid 6) Oregon State plated two more runs to take a commanding lead on the Ducks. If the Oregon offense doesn't get off the deck late, the Ducks will be looking at their second loss of the year.
Beavers 5, Ducks 1 (End 5) Oregon State reliever Jack Giordano came out of the bullpen and pitched a perfect fifth inning.
Beavers 5, Ducks 1 (Mid 5) Oregon State got to Meckna and scored three big runs in the fifth to extend their lead to 5-1. Proctor hit his third double of the game to make it 3-1 before a wild pitch and a sacrifice bunt brought in two more runs for the Beavers.
Beavers 2, Ducks 1 (End 4) Oregon was able to get runners on the corners with two out, but Beaver reliever Noah Scott was able to strike out Jack Brooks looking to end the threat.
Beavers 2, Ducks 1 (Mid 4) Michael Meckna came out of the bullpen and had to pitch around a walk and a hit-batsman to work his way out of the inning. Fortunately for Oregon, he held the Beavers scoreless in the frame.
Beavers 2, Ducks 1 (End 3) Oregon managed to have two runners on, but Ryan Cooney was thrown out trying to advance on a wild pitch and the Ducks couldn't muster up any offense after that.
Beavers 2, Ducks 1 (Mid 3) Oregon State takes the lead on a solo home run from Paul Vasguez and a run-scoring double from Josh Proctor.
Ducks 1, Beavers 0 (End 2) Oregon State pitcher Connor Mendez rebounded from a rough first inning to throw a perfect 1-2-3 frame for the Beavers.
Ducks 1, Beavers 0 (Mid 2) Smith preserved the one-run lead with a nice diving stop at third base with one out with a guy on third base. That was the second out and Gosztola coaxed AJ Singer to ground out to short to end the inning.
Ducks 1, Beavers 0 (End 1) Maddox Molony got the Ducks on the board with a ground-rule double in left field. Oregon had runners on second and third, but Drew Smith flew out to center to end the inning.
Beavers 0, Ducks 0 (Mid 1) Oregon starting pitcher Miles Gosztola hit a batter, but promptly picked him off of first as the Ducks come up to bat for the first time on the day.
